g.text: Any protocol, quantum-safe: its admin keys move to PQAdmin
One button at opaque.credit/sepolia/quantum-safe · live on Sepolia · OpenZeppelin's ProxyAdmin, beacons, Ownable, AccessControl and AccessManager
Before: one ECDSA key decides everything
Q-Day: whoever derives this key from its public key
upgrades, pauses or drains the protocol
at most 8 signatures, then the next
Anyone may submit a signed call: paying authorises nothing · the key rotates, and PQAdmin names the team's address, not a key, so nothing changes
Found and handed over: an owner (two-step too) · a ProxyAdmin or EIP-1967 admin · a beacon · every AccessControl role · an AccessManager's admin role
